senses.gloss: m.(b. h. v. סְגֵי I; cmp. רַב) grandee, chief, viceroy.
units: Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 134 כלי … אין לס׳ רשות וכ׳ the viceroy is not permitted to use a vessel which the king has used.—[Num. R. s. 15; Tanḥ. Bhaăl. 11 למחר ס׳, v. פָּגָן.]—Esp. סְגַן הכהנים or הסָּ׳ the chief of the priests, adjutant high priest.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:9">Yoma III, 9</cite>. Y. ib. III, 41ᵃ top <he>לא היה … עד שנעשה ס׳</he> none could be appointed high priest, unless he was made a Sagan first. Sifra Tsav, Milluim, Par. 1 <he>נעשה משה ס׳ הכ׳ לאהרן</he> Moses was Aaron’s aid; <he>וכשם שנעשה לו ס׳ בחייו וכ׳</he> and as he was his aid in his life-time, so was he his aid in his dying hour; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סְגָנִים</he>, <he>סְגָנִין</he>, constr. <cite ref="O00568"><he>סִגְנֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00067"><he>סִי׳</he></cite>. Es. R. s. 1 <he>מי שם הס׳ אלמים וכ׳</he> who made the chiefs (Pharaoh’s counsellors) mute &c.?; Tanḥ. Sh’moth 10.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:12:1">Cant. R. to VI, 12</cite> <he>כשנעשו … ונעשו ס׳ על וכ׳</he> when they were made free men and were redeemed and made the primates of all entering this world; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 992:43">Yalk. ib. 992</cite> <he>נעשו חורין וס׳ וכ׳</he> they were made nobles and primates &c.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:4">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>אחיו כ״ג ובניו סגני כהונה</he> his brother is high priest and his sons the high priest’s aids; a. fr.—[<he>סגניו</he>, <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 20:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. XX</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="O00567"><he>סִיגְנוֹן</he></cite>.—<cite ref="O00570"><he>סִגְנִים</he></cite>, Y’lamd. to Num. X, 2, quot. in Ar., v. <cite ref="O00567"><he>סִיגְנוֹן</he></cite>.]
